authority.figma: design baseline, validation widths, page gutters and adaptation intent

validationViewports.label: 小屏笔记本
validationViewports.expectation: 收紧页面边距，筛选项换行，表格横向滚动

validationViewports.label: 普通笔记本
validationViewports.expectation: 保持核心布局，减少非核心列

validationViewports.label: 高分屏笔记本或 1920 屏幕 125% 缩放视口
validationViewports.expectation: 保持核心布局，内容自然延展

validationViewports.label: 外接显示器
validationViewports.expectation: 增加页面边距，展示更多内容

validationViewports.label: 2K 或超宽屏
validationViewports.expectation: 限制内容最大宽度，避免无限拉伸

rules: 1440px is the default design baseline, not a fixed page width.
1536px is a validation viewport and does not create a separate media query.
Use flexible layout before adding viewport breakpoints.
At narrow widths preserve core information; allow filters to wrap and data tables to scroll horizontally.
At wide widths add useful information or columns before stretching components.
At 2560px and above center content and limit its maximum width to 1920px.
